verdict.rationale: Angular's docs mention Signals providing 'fine-grained reactivity' for state updates, which supports explicit, traceable data flow, but there's no first-party or community evidence specifically addressing debugging/tracing state changes versus two-way bindings, and Angular still supports two-way binding (ngModel) alongside signals. missing for 10: detailed docs on signal-based debugging/dev-tools tracing, community confirmation that this replaces two-way binding pain points, and discussion of coexistence with legacy two-way binding.
